name: Accepted domains and DKIM
description: Lists accepted domains with whether DKIM signing is configured and enabled, its status and the selector CNAME values Exchange expects to be published.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.label: Domains
parameters.help: Domains to show. Leave blank to show every accepted domain.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read organisation and DKIM configuration.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
No DNS query is made. The selector CNAME values are what Exchange expects, not proof they are published; SPF and DMARC are not checked.
A domain with no DKIM signing configuration is listed with DkimConfigured False and DkimEnabled NotConfigured.
A named domain that is not accepted in this tenant is listed as NotAccepted.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
